# External art credits

Only files under `kenney/` are third-party. Titles in `assets/shared/` and tones in `assets/audio/` are generated by this project (see `docs/HOUNDS_ASSETS.md`).

## Platformer Pack Redux

- Author: Kenney Vleugels, for Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
- License: Creative Commons Zero, CC0 1.0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Pack page: https://opengameart.org/content/platformer-pack-redux-360-assets
- Author site: https://kenney.nl
- Local license copy: `kenney/License.txt`
- Credit is not required by the license. Kenney asks that credit be given when you can: Kenney or www.kenney.nl

The aliens are stand-ins for the hound-knight and the feline garrison. They are not those characters. Retouch notes are in `docs/HOUNDS_ASSETS.md`. The pack's mouse sprite is unused.
